summary: Capital One Auto Receivables, LLC and Capital One, National Association entered an underwriting agreement dated September 9, 2026 with J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities and RBC Capital Markets for notes issued by Capital One Prime Auto Receivables Trust 2026-1. Publicly registered notes include $543.76M Class A-2-A at 4.48%, $150M Class A-2-B at SOFR+0.37%, $693.76M Class A-3 at 4.77% and $112.48M Class A-4 at 4.88%, alongside $336.4M Class A-1 and retained subordinated classes. Total notes aggregate $1.97459B, closing on or about September 17, 2026. This is a routine auto-loan ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation.
